label: Feedback moves (template)
summary: Short pieces of guidance on giving feedback, each for a moment in learning. A template: replace them with what your research says.

items.text: Before correcting a wrong answer, ask the learner to say how they got it: the mistake is often in a step they can find themselves.
When a learner asks for the answer, name what they have already done, then offer the smallest next step.
When a learner has tried more than once, change the representation rather than repeating the hint: a picture, a number line or a simpler case.
With unlike denominators, ask what the two fractions need to have in common before asking them to add.
